mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.file_url, r.external_link, r.resource_type, r.purchased_note, r.uploader_id, r.download_type, r.points_needed, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, u.username as uploader_username FROM resources r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.uploader_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE resources SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resources WHERE uploader_id = #{userId} AND name = #{fileName} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
